**The SC Legislature passed a budget. Communities lost the most with no earmarks.**
South Carolina state government has been operating under a continuing resolution since July 1 because the legislature was unable to finalize a spending plan before the start of the new fiscal year.
Budget writers set aside $377.7 million for lawmaker projects in a separate piece of legislation. They gave themselves a Sept. 30 deadline to allocate the money, but lawmakers would have had to come back in the fall to approve a supplemental spending bill, which risks the possibility of negative headlines on certain projects less than two months before the November election.
Budget negotiators had agreed to have a joint committee decide how much money each earmark received. That went out the window as budget writers tried to resolve earmark funding before Tuesday’s session, and communities are the ones who will lose the most.[ Read more here.](https://us.list-manage.com/103CwmVInFp?e=edbde6c9b1&c2id=d580cd1bdfbc15e62e8fc86070aa989a)

We had a full week with our Run, Ladies, Run! Event that raised $7,500 to support getting out the vote this Fall and we attended the Spartanburg Rotary Club meeting with local candidates.
Mallory Dittmer for Congress hosted a town hall in Boiling Springs, Sylvia Wright for Superintendent of Education held a listening session for voters at Travelers Rest Baptist Church in Spartanburg, Irene Benson for House District 32 engaged with voters at the meet and greet in Converse Heights, and our candidates knocked doors on Saturday morning.
I had the pleasure of meeting with Pete Buttigieg in Columbia on Saturday before we hosted Dr. Annie Andrews at The Beacon on Sunday with an energetic crowd of supporters. Then I headed to Nashville to attend the pARTisan art exhibit and meet the incredible women building the TN Table...and I got to meet Anna Golladay who is running against a 30 year incumbent in Chattanooga.
Democracy is a participatory sport y’all, and it’s time to ramp up. Stay with me!

Williams drew a clear contrast between her primary opponent, offering substantive answers on affordability, ensuring America’s influence in the world, maintaining border security, defending individual liberty, and bringing common sense back to Washington. “Tonight, Granite Staters saw the choice clearly,” said Williams. “I have the organization, resources, grassroots support, and conservative record to win this primary and defeat Maggie Goodlander in November.” The debate victory adds to Williams’ sustained momentum ahead of the September state primary.
**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

body:

---
Hi friend, it's Deb.

Over the past couple weeks, I’ve been traveling across New Mexico on my third statewide tour. My Roadrunnin' Tour is all about meeting New Mexicans right in their communities, listening to what’s on their minds, and sharing my plans to change the game for our state.
**[_Friend, with 68 days left in this race, will you chip in $5 right now so I can keep hitting the road, listening to New Mexicans, and meeting folks in every corner of our state?_](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15424?refcode=jtk1253-fr-nd&t=2&akid=12047%2E400544%2EErOYPp)**

Here’s a look at some of the stops I’ve made along the way:
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15360?refcode=jtk1253-fr-nd&t=3&akid=12047%2E400544%2EErOYPp)
I started in Alamogordo and have traveled all across the state, from Alto and Rio Rancho to Deming, Silver City, Las Cruces, Socorro, and so many communities in between. Every stop has given me the opportunity to hear directly from New Mexicans about what’s happening in their communities, what they’re most concerned about, and what they want to see from their next Governor. These conversations have been a reminder of why I’m running: to listen, to bring people together, and to deliver real results for families in every corner of our state.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15360?refcode=jtk1253-fr-nd&t=4&akid=12047%2E400544%2EErOYPp)
From celebrating the traditions that bring us together to seeing the people and organizations working every day to make their communities stronger, I’ve gotten to experience so much of what makes New Mexico special. I’ve met families, farmers, artists, students, and community leaders, and each conversation has given me another reason to keep showing up and fighting for the future we can build together.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15360?refcode=jtk1253-fr-nd&t=5&akid=12047%2E400544%2EErOYPp)
Here’s the truth, friend, no matter where I am, it’s clear that New Mexicans want the same things: affordable, accessible healthcare, a strong education for their kids, safe communities, and the ability to pay the rent and buy groceries in the same month.

That’s what I’m fighting for. Every conversation I have is critical in shaping my vision for a stronger, more affordable future for every New Mexican.

**With less than three months to go until Election Day, every door, every conversation, and every vote matters more than ever before.[_Please, will you chip in $5 or more right now to help power my campaign for Governor and reach voters in every corner of New Mexico?_](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15360?refcode=jtk1253-fr-nd&t=6&akid=12047%2E400544%2EErOYPp)**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/15360?refcode=jtk1253-fr-nd&t=7&akid=12047%2E400544%2EErOYPp)
---
Together, we’re going to build a New Mexico for all New Mexicans.

Thank you, and be fierce,

Deb
|

This campaign is all about changing that – and election analysts say we have a strong shot at winning in November. subject: Texas is losing roughly a farm a week due to data centers
body:
Abbott has sold out rural Texas farmland to tech corporations.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Across Texas, tech corporations are rushing to build massive AI data centers, and our rural communities are paying the price.
**Texas is losing roughly a farm a week.** Mega-corporations are swallowing up our farmland and consuming massive amounts of local groundwater, often targeting rural counties that lack the oversight ability needed to protect their own resources.
Instead of protecting our land and water, Greg Abbott has taken millions in donations from the data center industry. He called for a pause, but a temporary pause isn’t going to cut it.
**Texas needs a governor who will actually fight back against corporate giants to protect our natural resources.**
Rural families rely on this land to earn a living and feed our state. Watching Abbott sell out these families to billionaire developers is a betrayal we simply can’t accept.
Texas can lead in innovation without sacrificing our communities.

Peter -

I never expected to be running for office. I have never had any desire to be a politician. I am doing this because I am answering President Donald Trump's call to serve and want to stand up for South Carolina and fight for his agenda.

_**Like Lindsey, I am a hard worker with a servant's heart.**_ We grew up in the back of a bar and liquor store, in one room. Our parents worked hard every day to make ends meet - there was no time for sickness and few vacations, because if the doors weren't open, no money was coming in.

What I've spent my life doing is serving South Carolina - including running a state agency with 130 employees and a $90 million budget. We turned it from a struggling organization into a national model helping people find work and live independently. We made sure all spending was reasonable, allowable, and necessary. _I fought against duplication of services, knowing it wasted taxpayers' dollars_.

clean_body: I am answering President Donald Trump's call to serve and want to stand up for South Carolina and fight for his agenda. | Peter - I never expected to be running for office. I have never had any desire to be a politician. I am doing this because I am answering President Donald Trump's call to serve and want to stand up for South Carolina and fight for his agenda. Like Lindsey, I am a hard worker with a servant's heart. We grew up in the back of a bar and liquor store, in one room. Our parents worked hard every day to make ends meet - there was no time for sickness and few vacations, because if the doors weren't open, no money was coming in. What I've spent my life doing is serving South Carolina - including running a state agency with 130 employees and a $90 million budget. We turned it from a struggling organization into a national model helping people find work and live independently. We made sure all spending was reasonable, allowable, and necessary. I fought against duplication of services, knowing it wasted taxpayers' dollars. I'm a mother, a grandmother, and a wife, and now South Carolina's first female United States Senator, I know how to bargain shop, and I look for the buy-one-get-one-free sales at the grocery store. I just bought a new pair of shoes to walk around the U.S. Capitol off the clearance rack at the Shoe Warehouse. I cut my own grass with a push mower, and yes, I know how to use a weed eater. I support the Right to Life. I believe in showing ID to vote to save our country. I oppose DEI. I think AOC is C-R-A-Z-Y. I think Anthony Fauci should stop staring at the floor and answer the questions. I stand for the national anthem. I believe our veterans are heroes. I will always Back the Blue. And I know that President Trump and I will Make America Great Again. I am the first woman United States senator in South Carolina history. My Democratic opponent, Dr. Annie Andrews, must not be the second. She supports turning confused little boys into little girls and vice versa. I believe that makes her the worst pediatrician in the country. President Trump wants a fighter in the Senate. That's exactly why he's in my corner in this race. Thanks, Darline Graham P.S. I'm not a politician. I'm a hard worker who answered President Trump's call to serve. And about the fact that** _**GEO staff lied to us**_ **about whether or not there was a hunger strike and which unit was participating.** Getting answers has been far harder than it should be. ICE leadership has put up barriers to congressional oversight — limiting our ability to access information about what is happening inside the facility. **We won’t accept that.** Members of Congress and the American people have a right to know how human beings in federal custody are being treated, and Congress has a responsibility to make sure ICE is held accountable. _**[I’m collecting signatures from folks in the 6th District so I make clear where we stand and to demand answers and accountability from ICE. clean_body: | Last weekend, Rep. Dexter and I went inside the Northwest ICE Detention Center in Tacoma after receiving numerous reports about a hunger strike and troubling conditions inside. We left with serious concerns – about access to medical care, the quality of the food being served, and when people are actually receiving their meals. And about the fact that GEO staff lied to us about whether or not there was a hunger strike and which unit was participating. Getting answers has been far harder than it should be. ICE leadership has put up barriers to congressional oversight — limiting our ability to access information about what is happening inside the facility. We won’t accept that. Members of Congress and the American people have a right to know how human beings in federal custody are being treated, and Congress has a responsibility to make sure ICE is held accountable. Breaking news:

Less than 48 hours after a Supreme Court ruling opened the door to Trump’s attempt to make it harder to vote, I filed a new lawsuit to protect mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections.

**[If that’s all you need to hear, rush a donation right now to power our work. Your support funds each and every one of these critical lawsuits to hold Trump and his administration accountable.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/138063884/642884061/2110272206?refcode=260827em_rb_vbmlawsuit-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZTliZTc0Ni04NmEyLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTliZWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-hqOqkpfWJZDJ4IIOz6He3fJgZOFqWq4_fouE6L9bKU=)****

_First,_ Trump issued an illegal Executive Order that directed the USPS to send mail-in ballots only to voters on a list of eligible mail voters provided by the states.
_Then_ , the USPS adopted an illegal rule to implement that order and compile a list of enrolled mail voters.

_Now_ , under the current USPS rules, if an eligible voter isn’t on the federal government’s official voter list, or if a ballot doesn’t meet specific new requirements, USPS can refuse to deliver a ballot to an eligible voter.

**Let me clear: it is against the law for USPS to discriminate among users of the mail and reject mail. The Constitution gives states — not the Postal Service or the President — the authority to regulate elections, period. So I’ve filed a lawsuit — my 86th against the Trump administration since he was inaugurated last year — challenging this unlawful USPS rule that restricts voting. **

The right to vote is what our nation was founded on, and it is the cornerstone of a functioning democracy. Now, Donald Trump is so terrified of losing the midterms that he is taking unprecedented measures to restrict that right and interfere with our elections — but this fight is far from over.

_The facts and the law are on our side, and we will never stop fighting to protect the constitutional right to vote for every single Californian and American._

body:
Donald Trump built an immigration enforcement system around fear and impunity. The No Kings Act is California’s answer. | |
Peter,

**We did it.

The California Legislature just passed my No Kings Act! We proved that holding federal agents accountable isn’t just _possible_ \- _it’s overwhelmingly popular_. The Assembly passed it 57–19 and the Senate 28–10.**

For the last year and a half, we have watched in horror as ICE and Border Patrol have rounded up our friends, neighbors, and family members - breaking into homes, violating people’s constitutional rights, and killing people in broad daylight.

And they have done it with almost no accountability. That impunity ends now.

**The No Kings Act allows Californians to sue ICE, Border Patrol, and other federal agents when they violate the Constitution.**

If Governor Newsom signs the bill, it will take effect immediately. We also made it retroactive to March 2025, so people whose rights have already been violated will have a path to justice.

I’ve spent ten years in the State Senate doing this work: taking on problems people call impossible, writing the legislation, building the votes, and getting it passed.

Throughout the debate, Engling drew a sharp contrast through his election oversight experience, small-business background and focused agenda for the office: protecting election integrity, cracking down on business filing fraud, increasing transparency and making the secretary of state's office more efficient and accountable to Hoosier taxpayers. body:

---
| MassGOP Chair - Vote September 1st
---
---
| My Fellow Republicans, As we approach the September 1 primary, I write to urge every Republican in Massachusetts to vote and remain actively engaged in our party's work.
Primaries are not optional exercises. They are the critical first step in choosing the strongest candidates who will carry our values into the general election. When Republicans stay home, we leave the selection of our nominees to a smaller, less representative group. When we show up, we ensure our candidates reflect the full strength and diversity of our party.
Your participation also sends a clear message: Massachusetts Republicans are ready to fight for better government.
Voting in the primary, volunteering, donating, and talking with neighbors are the practical steps that grow our ranks and strengthen our infrastructure for the long term.
---
| |
---
| We also have the opportunity to write in Anne Brensley for Secretary of State, ensuring another critical statewide office is challenged on the November ballot.
Accountability is not optional in a healthy democracy--it is the foundation. When one party controls every statewide office for decades, the result is complacency, reduced transparency, and a government that answers more to itself than to the people.
By writing in Anne Brensley, Massachusetts voters can send a clear message: no position is beyond scrutiny, and every statewide office should face real competition. That is how accountability is restored and how better government is built.
Every Republican vote in the primary matters. It shapes the quality of our nominees, expands our base, and positions us to hold one-party rule accountable. I ask you to make the time to vote on September 1, encourage your fellow Republicans to do the same, and stay involved in the weeks and months ahead. Together, we can build a stronger, more competitive Republican Party in Massachusetts.
Sincerely,
---
| |
---
| Amy Carnevale Chairman, Massachusetts Republican Party

| | Friends,
It was humbling to be officially nominated as the Republican candidate for Attorney General at our convention in Mt. Pleasant this week.
I want to start by thanking all the delegates who voted for me to be the nominee and the supporters who helped make it happen. I also want to thank my family for being with me every step of the way on this journey.
I've spent my career in courtrooms, working with law enforcement, standing with victims and their families, making tough decisions, and holding criminals accountable.For nearly three decades as a prosecutor, I've made decisions based on the evidence, the facts, and the law. That is exactly what I will bring to the Attorney General's office.
Michigan deserves fair law, not more lawfare like we've seen under Dana Nessel.
And that is where this election presents a very clear choice.
Tomorrow, Democrats will formally nominate my opponent, Eli Savit. Savit will be an even more extreme version of Nessel should he be elected Attorney General.
As Washtenaw County Prosecutor, Savit has refused to do his job.
On his watch, innocent people have been [shot](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O3lNinGAx72WcPYiS9PfTH9Gvd0x8EZoVKEt080I0kWKjcmCgJRAb1O7J0covEGUP0VLya6QMoCtUBjLdYkCtJeTrIecIUpiD3AspHb8gnjH1NlISfOc4HodW8vYI0jRy2twVnG28TaVjBGTyif_mFZGj0Sq6Upg0FLO1ZxEcu_IWivAj9F2GZrS1SiKXWX4djsRVnBW5-33p_85ZNMozLRe_P9-58srR0cw4pUdCX4dmJSvPziJBr0R9dumfb_Z&c=skdfmZmP2RXt2XBr4MHls8siiIhe_iQwY3UQmO4SVh1uPQdH94VDJw==&ch=7NB4zvg_FLXB5a29UYp-pS1VByIixBpt6CIbw34jbw0r5q1hxmwQUw==) or [killed](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O3lNinGAx72WcPYiS9PfTH9Gvd0x8EZoVKEt080I0kWKjcmCgJRAb3wgMt2-ZkpbBkOCZgALuh4wBQuEEDxxAzBPb0XAL6qDR4QwgsNEqT4xM3tN_q5K7RYvHB9LS0qSdXoVI0fUv1yDwnZ9H5UzO_S7hJrAOah7cQEyZHKu3A4vyfLxPO_ihfRcNHkksyXvHl4YdlXQi3usfS5RCJVl8L0y-GcK6ZT9hAON9vtl4SLrMOeDK8plTgn97oj8_ETrFik5-OezzIU1Ut2NfKvNhq9f_6MC9-XY&c=skdfmZmP2RXt2XBr4MHls8siiIhe_iQwY3UQmO4SVh1uPQdH94VDJw==&ch=7NB4zvg_FLXB5a29UYp-pS1VByIixBpt6CIbw34jbw0r5q1hxmwQUw==) because he let criminals off easy.
Last week, [a federal judge ruled](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O3lNinGAx72WcPYiS9PfTH9Gvd0x8EZoVKEt080I0kWKjcmCgJRAb3wgMt2-ZkpbX74wKD53lv64dIfcrp-iR2wQVT78lAxV8TxOWC4DbtiZ0H4o9Qp2Zv5QIJtRLU8uHoqWW5kiFczFdKR5-dtZXRgGA4msUtTragY8OkIM02pAHQ0xqt9ORhYZ2y6zF2_F39LuHfNxfmiCoifCVDxM44SrX77Fg_y2646H8PFBdYvcF9jWubz1C2vUvWD8aG592gJRRHY1wllAtl6j4INnO8fCyk7sqae2bQOnBmnxY749RWkLSk9JdVICz5aMvBdoAPYr8dUHETbG9nhto76osg==&c=skdfmZmP2RXt2XBr4MHls8siiIhe_iQwY3UQmO4SVh1uPQdH94VDJw==&ch=7NB4zvg_FLXB5a29UYp-pS1VByIixBpt6CIbw34jbw0r5q1hxmwQUw==) Savit can continue to not prosecute illegal immigrants that commit crimes, no matter how heinous, in Washtenaw County if it could trigger "immigration consequences."
He has [legalized psychedelic drugs and prostitution](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O3lNinGAx72WcPYiS9PfTH9Gvd0x8EZoVKEt080I0kWKjcmCgJRAb3wgMt2-ZkpbiB3uo5otCHW48bphsWcXxgQy7okC4SqsUXb8DLZClA0H77bRIIcT5cnULfoZ2yRVMxNzbFfR-CeNYz33Ea1yjp2Obv0Q6QhVNcg84wQylRzkhSxcAQKvd_MjQzmBGK-OMBKPi_XCC6m3xhL3bK8br2YnCSZfPYoGNp_wFDGQ1DVyT3MJA2RjYLmeHJhT0aduHpQhNr6-6UhxJQh3_4dl-A==&c=skdfmZmP2RXt2XBr4MHls8siiIhe_iQwY3UQmO4SVh1uPQdH94VDJw==&ch=7NB4zvg_FLXB5a29UYp-pS1VByIixBpt6CIbw34jbw0r5q1hxmwQUw==) and [ended cash bail](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O3lNinGAx72WcPYiS9PfTH9Gvd0x8EZoVKEt080I0kWKjcmCgJRAb3wgMt2-ZkpbOgfpqYT57pknpwzKcjhv6IT5DlOM0RdEgIRPsuwBQJHIYanDAAMR9zAFvNRXY1S2jYUZvY5SdhGiDj43EzKUIZ9UuxLhjgUyWduYCMchnNizq3wQEj739ihRHsOf9T6bvELdaJH09BVi5ev54DjN5LyJ7riIPyotyGdlPhMch9xatUEnPy_5Q1AsuYUCdE8c&c=skdfmZmP2RXt2XBr4MHls8siiIhe_iQwY3UQmO4SVh1uPQdH94VDJw==&ch=7NB4zvg_FLXB5a29UYp-pS1VByIixBpt6CIbw34jbw0r5q1hxmwQUw==).
Eli Savit is a prosecutor who won't prosecute. He refuses to do his job and now he wants a promotion to be Michigan's top law enforcement official?
Michiganders who care about their safety have an easy decision to make in November when they vote for Attorney General.
I am proud to have earned the support of the Michigan Fraternal Order of Police, more than 60 county prosecutors, over 30 sheriffs, the Michigan Chamber of Commerce, and the Michigan Farm Bureau.
Law enforcement, small businesses, and our agriculture industry all know they can trust me as Attorney General. They know I will put the law first and politics last.
Winning the nomination was just the first step. Now we need to win in November. I would love to have your help and support in doing that.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecutor Republican Nominee for Attorney General

# [My "Lawrence of Arabia" Theory of Politics.](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=5233352&post_id=213007190&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MjEzMDA3MTkwLCJpYXQiOjE3ODc5MTYwMzMsImV4cCI6MTc5MDUwODAzMywiaXNzIjoicHViLTUyMzMzNTIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.6Udmra4ry28NutfX6NJmWJHynieympu_xwOGD2Kd-J0)
### Meet Jake Young.

---

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/859aede2-3c1c-4c57-a819-b6c702e38a7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I have my father to thank for introducing me to _Lawrence of Arabia._ It became one of my all-time favorites the moment Peter O'Toole declared, "Nothing is written," having demonstrated that one man with purpose could overcome the traditional odds. Increasingly, I meet men and women who feel exactly this way in the "reddest" parts of Pennsylvania, where conventional wisdom says liberal-minded people are a powerless minority. With an understated defiance, they're organizing, protesting, and running for office anyway. They don't always get the short-term "win," but their fighting spirit is the _sine qua non_ for moments like this [massive](https://substack.com/redirect/d18f9b53-668f-468e-af35-67f465947e49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) special election victory we just had in Butler County.
As long as that spirit is alive, we have a reason to hope.
A perfect example is my friend Jake Young, who was filling out his primary ballot by mail this past spring, when he saw no Democrat was running to be his state representative. He refused to cede the race, so with three weeks until Election Day, Jake organized a write-in campaign and got double the number of required signatures to get on the ballot. He's now our nominee and he's spent the summer working hard in a county where Trump won by 20 points.
It's worth two minutes of your time to hear from Jake about why he refused to let a Republican walk into this state house seat, and the importance of making our voices heard everywhere:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/4928ef96-3d4c-47a2-9dae-612cc69e571f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
You can learn more about Jake's campaign and support him [here.](https://substack.com/redirect/2146cecb-c3d1-4f63-be51-00d0d5782440?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) And if you'd like to become a paid subscriber of this Substack, that helps me amplify people like Jake. Have a great weekend.

## Nearly 1,500 Missing in Himalayan Flood
Two days after a wall of mud and water buried villages along the Nepal-Tibet border, nearly [1,500 people remain missing](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LtuwyAUxvGnwVssbsHHA0MXb-naEWE4xERcIkzt5u2r9BU6f9JP-v5fN3OzMcVy_7QZdQ_VFDz3hL1jM1vMNtmXLSHV6hvu7hsbFpsNp1xdKFw4GOt6PNBIO3gdEDmKATWbYJoZg1kNm17XCVY5g2IACpRHevVeSeuZRDkJMUT99ihwYJQxIUd39UEqKmchZyYCJZKij7228VFj6RuG9KoHttHVPCS99f7cifggfCF8Oc9zXFf33ghf3ncIX1I8kPDFqRfkRy7Pn4P2oWn_PGNKcVcTkfSebUx_ZP9niUPz3wAAAP__odtySQ), including 65 Americans. More than 13,000 troops and police are searching, rescuing 573 survivors yesterday alone. Scientists say the disaster began when [a glacier's base](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAQhp8GOwwgChYU19jttVeaiYw6tygb4Nbs21_Y5J7gusl8yT_zf1-3-QYU6Nw-4UBX1jifeOWApWCadzogwAvONcToE-blBxOecMxKqIELy5WdYSn0xFlD492KqLBr0EljzSilHYdmd1qsI3jUvUUv-0EaY0aNfWcWpVBZ05CrecIqK4WUnW6X3q96EHrs9Ci7VTAt0FOJqf2OdJYd1_CKT0ztEo8muL2UR2bdB1MTU9N1Xe09Q6mQqan2qduYgmdqqpeYmoSts3nzBwT-bpj5TtseaNsL31K86Nz4FmAhTDxRvmdOJ78gHRX8yanhTXL-cVEIlAfDtNgOoPB-rvzT6dOp3wAAAP__Y5eLbA) sheared off as if someone had "cut with a huge knife" through it, sending a debris flow that raised the river 30 feet in 30 minutes. On the ground, rescuers are digging survivors out of the mud. [Watch the rescues here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFu9CAUBODT4G4teLwf44Lib9xt2pSIhYfNCpsNJrb29pFzhXQjjfRJM593e3cpp23-cCuZFovd6NwztUbVLml12b3dFnMpodLuv6nS5lYLHNSN6xto63xLB1l0XTCRCEh2ZMSgh1EIPapuMdLrwUsng3KBPIHgGB6j5DqiB4zYJXN5XIMWXAiJvf8XIiqOo8RRyMgZcgqpldo_S9raQjG_y0G192Xtsllae-1M_mcwMZjO8-wfD391DKZrDoPpSIHKFfyXkihFnfOzdNWE15lyTrsaGPJ5dSn_mu2PVxwGfgIAAP__c9ZyvA). One tour group vanished after sending a video nine minutes before the flood hit. _"Everything is under mud,"_ its operator told the media. Many of the missing were pilgrims bound for a [sacred mountain](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OhDAMhU8DXVASMvwUKbahm223RJ7EAa8MQUlm0Nx-xVxhK_uTJet97-c-34GY9uUbNrQlxHnHMzOWgmleaQOGN-yBY_QJs3tiwh22WUvdCTkIPczgCr1wNlB7GxA1tjVa1Q_9qNQwdvVqFcIYgnKqv6ECGfrOSehbL5Xx8BhDTfb6Jwc9KKlUaxp388F00oytGVUbZGUkeioxNb-R9rJi4Hd8YWpc3Gq2aylHrtqvSk-Vns7zbNwjXx7XvdLTtX7GASwKPbCIjXKmfRGBIa_i43fh9vQXnGJhcIRJuMgMR8ZKT3Wy_jiJmXLXV0YuGxB_EpR_Fvey-i8AAP__2EmFSg) in Tibet, where China tightly controls access and information. Officials warn that a lake forming behind the debris could burst and flood the valley again. **_Editor 's Note:_**_If you 'd like to help those impacted by the devastating floods in the Himalayas, The Flyover is matching the first _**_$4,000 in donations to our partner, Convoy of Hope_** _in direct response to this tragedy.[Learn more here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuunDAYhJ_GdCDfALtwcRS03aZNif5jfoMjX5AxrPbtI6LNE6T9RvNpNL-e8xN88Gn9CRFNdXlO-DoC1opl3nyEAG9ILuS8FDzsiQUTxJlTPrRUtVzNYKu_cJbQLMYhchQNGjaqUTOm9NBsRrOht8CYU_33d6-Vpg6k0hK1pgwob7y5fVRxxShjQna2X5wcqNRCaiYcJZLi4msu3e_sU93QhXe-sHQ2xyaYrdb9IOKL8AfhD5vTld_ZbXnHLpf1puJx1jgf-SwWiZg-dcKHG0dc_BmJmDCCDx9oIe7g10TE9OPr2VI6aiX-ZTlVTJWIKUH1OUFoU2iKWfaXD8Efw0gkXW_Z34H1P3-9DP8TAAD__1YejVQ)._
## Amish Threaten NY Exodus over Vaccines
New York's Amish community, 25,000 strong, is [threatening to leave](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLvO2zAMhZ9G3hhI8iXy4KGLt79rR0OV6IitLoFEJ83bF-ordPsAEh95zo-v48tSpPz4bhNufJYj47tFZMZ6BEo22o_NZyzFV2zuworZpkNLvYA0oM1hHdMLj8kOfjsRNY4Dbupu7qtSZl2GsDk135UzqNyCq_E_l9Wuep6UdbOUq58H2rpPGm2UVGqcbm7257TIaR2nVY2nFJNET1zq7VehzAHP-CkvrDdX0hC3wPxsYvwm9C70nj_P0riPhN67WOhdms6drgY9odC7TdQCcKhoGTMk2xrgn-KvBmctqa_Bp9Tf0C_ByzpHGeGkR2B4B3IBqEFA6yk_gAtwQGjXs2JCcOWqLPQ-1M0_3xQjteUuJvlIluK_r_k_y35t-m8AAAD__wrrlTo) the state for good as its fight against school vaccine mandates heads to the Supreme Court. The battle dates to 2019, when then-Gov. Andrew Cuomo ended religious exemptions to the state's [school immunization requirements](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D1uwyAUAODT4C2IPwMeGLp4S9eOFoFH_CoMFia2cvuqvUIv8A3f1325e8xYnp9-A9dTXQpcR4beoS0rbj77ty8p1xobHOEFDYrfFsGEvjF7E3bxoeMJi_JDdAlAgBzAcWPNxLmd9LC6iY06QBq9YWN82ACGa2O1NkmnUUU5oPv1mBWWM86lomGMSWmmJqkmLhMjikHEXhv9rlj6Cim_6wmNhroN2a297weRH0TMRMzXddEVfO4rLW_6rCcR8_56ZAy-Yy0HEbOQhtE9pqG5uF-YMx7aEMWem8f8h_Z_XpxO_AQAAP__x8VzKg) after a measles outbreak. Three one-room Amish schoolhouses have since racked up $118,000 in fines for refusing to comply. Last December, the Supreme Court ordered an appeals court to take another look. The court [ruled against the Amish](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO8yAUhE-DO1vwINgUFH_jLn-7pfUCj5gIGwtIotx-lay0F9hupBmNZr6v83LGmOJ-_Y8b2RbystOzJmqNyrLGDRO-cA8pZ1-oujsV2nFbgIPu-dTDtKBr8UGLws7bQAQkO7JinEYjxGR0t1pxInkZlQNwQTvt-eVC42hQGm0EH00X7buPTzAJLoRUgzv5oDRXRiojZOBMcfKx5TLcctzbSiG98oPK4PLWJbu2dlQm_zGYGcwJn8PtXlvEt81gdlipMpgDeSqYGMx4HJQSNupdvpdWPyFgMIPq9SR-Rf_zU_eSD2vbUlesP54xpVj1yBS_bhjTZ0T7I7uHhe8AAAD___29f-E) again in June, and their lawyers plan to petition the high court next month. If they lose, attorneys say the community will pack up its buggies for Pennsylvania, home to about 95,000 Amish. _"Our Almighty God wants us to fully put our faith and trust in Him,"_ one Amish father wrote in a handwritten letter explaining the refusal.
## Dolly Gave Away More Than She Kept
Dolly Parton, who died Tuesday at 80, built a [$450 million fortune](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFvgzAQBeBfAxvobBxjBg9d2NK1IzrZ5-DG2Km5JOLfV_QvdPuGp6en93VdrhhTzLdP3MhyKEum956Imeqyxg0THphDKsVX2t2TKmXcFglSd2A6aRZ0HF-0KGy9DUSShpasGM04CWEm3a520pIU-NELMw4OtR5RT4ouJIIOxlAb7dkHRhoBQgyqdxcflAY1DWoSQ4BGAfnIpfbfJWZeKaSjvKj2rmxtsivzY2-Gj0bOjZxDzJgd9QeupZyJRs4b1jvx3sh55-LuJ7BydIlO-pLS0T2wcsldJu7epfLa_TyJcgcgDcAIl37lLbXV-sc7phR3PTYKbhvG9DeD__ney8rfAAAA__8QJoTc) from a childhood in a one-room Tennessee cabin. By some estimates, she gave away even more, roughly $500 million. Her defining deal was one she turned down. In 1974, Elvis Presley's manager [demanded half](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDvO4yAURleDOyxedkxBMY27f9opLQyX-I4wNwISK7sfJVuY-nvo6Pz52X48Ziz33_4E1xNtBa6WoXeo24Gnz_7tS8pEsUILT6hQ_LkpoWYuFq6WzYeOL9iMH6JLAAr0AE7elpuVcrHzcDiVpjQFH4M2YrLCyGXa9S6SALOrEOYB3edPLGqRQkptxjDFZGZhrDZW6iSYERCxUx3_EpZ-QMpvekEdA51Ddkfvj8b0L6ZWptbrukYs4ZMxte4VfeGBSq9QfWNqjZTzmz987VT4_mxYoDUeIWBDKo2bSfATc0YqvEDnF9V-8O_qIopMrVZqO5vJDtXFx_WptvnGjLifHvOXqf-nypdT_wIAAP__kyeKRg) the publishing rights to _I Will Always Love You_. _"Something in my heart says, don't do that,"_ she later recalled. Whitney Houston's 1992 cover of that song earned Parton an estimated $20 million. She kept her name on the rest of her business, too: [half of Dollywood](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu2zAQRL9G6tbgQ1eiChZp3N20KYW94tLagA-B3Fjx3wdOPiH1DAZzzo_P7RM5cXl8x0xeYt0KXT2RCLXt4IwJX1hiqjU06vsvalQwb0aZGZQD4zbchZ-0TTgGH4kM2ZG8Xtyyau3WeTy8VUHTF4bFfaC1Sn2hihg1arMuu400sn_vKWecVlrb6bZ_hDjNalrttGob1TApCiy13X5WLnJQTK_6pHbbax6TP0TOPthvg7kP5n5d1-1snEk4_6sM5v6memcHCnCHUFN6wYlNaoEOhQSu2uSAQIKcOtDvM9VGATAKNcBMjXcs0Lk8qEGHQCgHoIBTY_PhvDgl7vMyTOqRkdPfa_KfRp_e_AkAAP__eKGOhw), her Tennessee theme park empire, and a 3,000-song catalog valued at $120 million. Her philanthropy was lifelong, and [much of the giving](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L3OozAQheGrMZ2R_xbswsU2dNl2SzTgIcxqsCPjBOXuV8ktfP2jo6P3722-ATHl-x84MLatzBmvk7E1rPNOBzC8IW9cSqp4rk-smOGYjTKDVF4aP8Pa6IWzgy7FDdGg7TDq0Y9Bax-Gbo8ujEGv1uigdQBAZf0C1ivltVNeLx3Fz57yxmultXX9-ittblAuWBe03ZRwChO1Uvt_hXLbceN3eWHt13J0HPfWHqewv4WZhJmu6-oXYl4K1PQRwkxMZzuFmVJhfssH1FayvJeSZEJMp2x0IFNGYSYdvJdtR_m118ds5ZkTNCpZmKmrMT0uYqZzGIVT9wOIv0faD_u9ovkfAAD__4XvhaM) went through her Dollywood Foundation, established in 1988. Its Imagination Library, a tribute to her father, who never learned to read, has mailed more than 330 million free books to children.

The antidote to Drag Queen Story HourAnd The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish.
| | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, **[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=9aa09928f6194c04baff7f707985a6cd&_e=qBlpmV5nDS8Y8--FzZ9eVLz-QEL-n6gAyBsCJG9MITT9xykgCgYFmP38rxvTteRWix2yDqM1m0HYX1eZlbZs_ptZ_zM138cxXapnu4KhtcLACgTam6Nv-Gy5wCWcHMWxLbYcuTU0iyTCCS1MPL7nYicJgajXuhR3o0MCldKoIEwbHZgLHDIG9Bz3bCbvq9cuIA47cvR7YfiL_7kor1ugJhgJlXAExCsM6Hc9hv8APhXcAJ24IVs0xS2Wir2mxuW9GIUHQxldnO69RMKCe9I7BT3rimjUz2ZtFzmTjPLJMee8vZvvaPjBZY5Nx459Os3uQ2f6Q1EbFhK_vqukzl7b8tKgjdUt33pPn86ZbQEuLA_XzODH-loAMsqoK0AVEx1FtQZBG_Q1raqxYHp0CIldjk6bPZqvKKF-ftJZEamkn9WIH_MyYQ98dLcDIw4uDhaXjuXwaM4UDwrqvRpgpv9dL2fvxookRVyxUNoAf0f9mDpY21G5DDwowswh3bRYNMgH6bVtZK66Fa9pLUjFXM4v4QBIF8gJV2HC0j83XHp7TzFJTG9JQqqicC8ER5o_ts3J8q3_FlTcnFN7ForY-hW2yLa1WtgwALuWK3JV0qQ05LYPlu_WJy0toRC8-Co2X6RlUyXpTqDYmRmTf30TFvEWFV4Ivwd6aJYYdhUtmhFRSLnLU2z_G6IlZHBEiGi-3uWD)** Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.**But today, all that has changed.** Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby._ “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. clean_body: The antidote to Drag Queen Story HourAnd The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. | | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers , Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ Little House series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true. THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour” For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. - Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,Kirk Cameron | | | 100 I-45 N 260Conroe, TX 77301

clean_body: I couldn't have done this without you, but we cannot take a day off. We need to look to November. | Thank you, Fellow Patriot. It's been a long six weeks, but because you were by my side, we won. Your generosity helped us through the Special Election Primary and through a head-to-head runoff. But that was just the first step to securing this seat. I am the first woman United States senator in South Carolina history. My Democratic opponent, Dr. Annie Andrews, cannot be the second. Here's where the race stands. Two statewide elections in less than 6 weeks were expensive. We knew it would be a tough battle - it was. We did not want to leave anything to chance, so we had to ensure every dollar we raised was well spent on television ads, voter contacts, and signs across South Carolina. We are starting at square one, going into the general election, and let me tell you about our Democrat opponent. She's raising millions from liberal donors who want nothing more than to flip this seat and stop President Trump's agenda in Washington. I need your help again, Fellow Patriot. Now that we're in the general election, we need to compete with the liberal money flooding South Carolina. I hate to ask for your help again, especially when you've been by my side for the last six weeks, but I wouldn't ask if I didn't need it. We won Tuesday night, but that's just the beginning. Let's make sure we win again in November. Thank you, Darline Graham P.S. Thank you for being by my side over the last few weeks. It means so much to me. We need to rebuild to win again in less than 70 days. | | Paid for by Darline Graham Majority Fund, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of Darline for Senate, Fund for America's Future, Security is Strength PAC, and NRSC. 228 S. ## ICE Officer Freed
An ICE officer [wanted in Minnesota](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAQhZ_G7rCA-LeguI273HZLawyDGQlDBLNx9u1XyStsf3TO-b6v-3YHipSO_3Ci4ZfPW8KrRmTGspHF7D1ZLL4gOg64FwRXw6alHoWchZ43sExP3HpondmlW1SLRk3ztKhBStUGM8DopPSLvtnJ7VNv3YCz1XZE2Svcl5bMu07OelZK3tTYLYOcenDWD87CgnPTS3TEuXQckPEF1cef_MTS2Xy20QTmR21u_xq9Nnq9rqvz-aXHkL8r5_QONXp9czV6JYsCDkwsTkoJa2YQdJ50FEgsasiZKR3isyJsKFSZIAkLlUtui3GPi2KkOk5NL48TKH5O8F_lPY3-DQAA____h4hV) for the January shooting of an immigrant walked out of a Cameron County jail at 6:59 a.m. Thursday. Christian Castro faces four assault counts for allegedly firing through a closed Minneapolis door on Jan. 14 and striking a Venezuelan man in the leg. Texas law caps extradition holds at 90 days, a deadline Castro reached Thursday after his May 29 arrest. U.S. District Judge Fernando Rodriguez Jr. [ruled Wednesday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOszAQRk9jOkfGAWwKF39Dl7_dEg32GGZlcGSPSPb2q0SrvcD2o_neex-3-QaU6Fj_w46OnzHPBz5qQmYsM3nMMZLHEgti4A2XghDqNmulB6ms1HYGz3Ti3EET3KLC2DboWmPN2PZKtc3mzOKVNT2oK4w2dGFZzBJ0HEf0gx90aMi93imrbduqaztcxl6ZDoKPffAwohWdwkCcy4U3ZHxCjekrn1guPu9NchvzvYrrP6EnoacKBxwrppzoxNeF0NNLSujJF9pR6OkX3wg9kUf5oyl3Og6smUG-ZyQ-uUAgpnzISOvG8l1CfgKlprhwf1BKVAcjOrXuQOlNxH8teTr9HQAA__-ou4qM) that Minnesota's lawsuit to keep him jailed wasn't "ripe for adjudication" because Gov. Greg Abbott hasn't decided on the extradition request. Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison said, "_Christian Castro will not escape justice in Minnesota_." Abbott's office says the state [is still investigating](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQRp8GOiPb4bdwcRu63HZLNLFnYFYGR2YS2LdfkVfY_tPRd87XfboDR97m_7Cik5PStOGxRxTBPLHHRMQeM2XEIAs-MkLYl8lq2yrdK9tP4IXfONVQBvfQYTAlOtP13WAarU25uK7WFEwT6EFGG-8H401NfrgNoaMWQsnuwune9sbom2mrodFdDcFTEzwM2Be1xsCSciULCp6wU_xJb8yVT2sZ3SLy3Ivbv8KOhR2P46gonR28duHtmhR2vKwKO7JHBTNuojJGhB2DopxW9YGqb-CogASz8umVReXX1Uatm8JTMgQWTpsinhcpswvPg2Pkve2KWs8rcPz8kb92fDv7GwAA____lIw8) whether Castro qualifies as a fugitive. If he does, a spokesman said, a governor's warrant "will be executed immediately."
## Abbott Proposes 3-Year College Degrees
Gov. Greg Abbott on Wednesday called on Texas public universities to [offer three-year bachelor's degrees](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAMgJ-GbFRA0oYMDLdk-2-9MTJgGutoiMBN27c_pa9wmyVL3_fZf36WH6BM2_03PNDxO5Vlw1fLyIx1oYAlJQpYU0WMvKKvCLGti1HmJpWVxi4QmA5cBuii8ypOukOnRztO-qqU7lZn0A66H0IarQ5-0mrQfcA0TQheeT125E6cssZqrXp9u0xXNQ4QQ7rGABNaMSiMxKVeeEXGN7SUP-XAegnl0WW3Mu9N9L-EmYWZ_x4E50KY-bxFmBnjMwBT2YSZT5Uws7LnPAozg_eFWe617KVhk738IFTpIayYS20y4r0iyrKfhCZTqfLbIPenzxTkc6MDayMmPGVddXF_Uc7UbqMY1P0BlL-h_L8PPpz5FwAA__8fWpGY) in high-demand fields. The accelerated degrees would require 90 credit hours instead of the traditional 120 and could save students up to $35,000 in tuition and living expenses. Abbott announced the plan at Stephen F. Austin State University in Nacogdoches. Abbott named information technology as one likely field and pointed to nursing as another, [with legislation expected in May](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAURE9jMiPbQGMCB5uQzaYboo9dbqx1Q8v-AzO3XzFX2Kykkl6V3p-P5YNSTvvzN73g-Csey46rZjCjLMnjiDF5lFiAwBvWAgp1W4wyD6msNHYhz-nE0lMT3KrCpBs4Pdpx0oNSutlcHEh3sQvGeu2BQFj7nnrjNa1Gx65J7sYpa6zWqtOPdhrU2FPwcQieJljRK4TER2l5A-OLaszfx4nS-uPVZLcxv6vofgkzCzNf19X-5YK7FGa-2cLMyt55FGamdT2Y5ed-IuUq35l2yVsB5DeoyJX8hnyUKgOeBajyZ1F-7ulEqYkTqjBzU1x4XynnVB-j6NXzRSn__OH_9Xg68y8AAP__gcCJvg) and programs ready for the next school year. Twenty-six states already offer reduced-credit bachelor's degrees. ## Ross Fire Destroys Family Business
A Graford family vowed to rebuild after the Ross Fire [destroyed their canoe-rental business](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGO5CAQheHT4KxaUMY2BA42cTabbmgVUIzR0s0IaHv69queK2z8pF_63p-P_YNSTo_P33TntX_Hsj_4apl757onzyXG5LnGyhz6wa4yhXbsKHEGaQDNTr6nk3dNQ1idDFYNvKrFLFZNUqrhWBelMQRCFyw66x1JO1ocI1lNSupxSOs7Jw0apeSo5pud5KIp-DgFT5aN0JJD6qXe-sGdv6nF_Con15sv9yGvR-9fTYy_BG4Ct-u6bn_PJ79HgRvVnnxmgdtbJnDLxVMWuP2EINI95Rec5WrQC1R2z5QDUOxcoZbWIKbKELj1Wl4N3LOlB7cG6QGflWKpQeCGZgEzTXGO3sOk3AJ60QR29hLmyeFIE83GuqGu4etKOac2L0LLzzul_KPo__v-ueK_AAAA__94ppoj) on land they have held since 1928. Rochelle's Canoe Rentals has operated along the Brazos River since 1969, on 50 acres Buddy Rochelle's grandfather bought for $500. _"Rochelle's will rise again,"_ he said after seeing the damage on Wednesday. The fire has burned [more than 85,000 acres](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb1iAsY0Hhi7e0rWj9YBHjERMBK92-vdV-gudr3R1zvm6bTdIOR33T3igpVcs24FXy0iEdUseS4zJY40VMdCOriKEtm9KqIkLw5XZwFM6cdPQBetEWGSHVs5mXuQohOx2q2SUYhhNdCEOs54G552UTisZHZohdMm-74RRRkoxyKlfRjFrCD6OwcOChmmBIVGpPe1I-IIW8085sfa-PLpsd6JnY8MHUytT63Vd_eF8iNd7Zmp9GzG15uIhM7XW4nfMGRv3cBTkFQ-C3PhZrsap8IruO-XAIRJWHvCERkDpuPNaWuMxVWRq1WIyk9JMrV214XmlnFObZqbF_QEp_5HRf4ueVv0GAAD__xfejSo) across Palo Pinto and Jack counties and was [just 21% contained](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSnCAYRZ8GOxxAXbWgSGP3p03pIFxW8rPifHy7bt4-s3mFdLe658z59bV-uZTTcf_pHrD8jmU9cNUMZtCaPEqMyYMiAYF3bAQX6r4aZW5STdJMq_OcXlh71wS7qTDrBlaP0zjrQSnd7Bazgopbpw0Gjy1sGPwQ5y6Oo49qME2ynzs1mUlr1elbOw9q7F3wcQjezZhErxASF2p5B-Ptasx_ygvU-vJost2Zzyq6H8IswiyxEF-FeCechbgtdBdm-SCEWdT02aMwy_nccvLS1W8EyUVWBkj6DEeyRPnb-W95ulzkmQ4u0pfnwQlVuio94apyc8wZ8ko5xEQQZmnIhvNKOad6G0Wv7g-X8j9H_t-2L2v-BgAA___OXpEM) Thursday morning, with nearly 200 firefighters on the lines. No injuries have been reported. Katie Rochelle's husband, a Mineral Wells firefighter, [saved the family's home](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO8yAQhJ8Gd7ZgbQdcUPyNu_ztlRawS7wSCRFwce7tT84rXDcjjb7RzNd1uzpO_Lj9d3ey7R3z9qCjJmqNysaBcowcqMRChG0nX8hh3TeQcOml6cFsLjR-0Ta5Dq2XuKiOrNJGL2qWUnW79T4Gj-AIIWg_AqGJOvhFBTmPkzMd2xMnDRil5KguwzJLPTkMccbgFjJikoTcchnaTo3ersb0k19UhpDvXbJ7a88qxn8CVgHrcRxDzO_pHHIGBKynFLCWXGsfuVD_gfQHJ_xY933rQXfF4vPglLhetJjk7e44fSraX695WfgNAAD__9K5ewI) as flames closed in. body:
As an East Tennessean, Corbin has one of the wildest résumés in progressive politics.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/7bcbebc840a8/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363841?e=dc5f639d62)

Hey friends,
I'm thrilled to share this episode with you. My guest this week is the one and only, Corbin Trent!

[**Click Here to LISTEN NOW**](https://us.list-manage.com/9sjfWZVxnY6?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
**Corbin has one of the wildest résumés in progressive politics.** His political awakening came listening to Bernie Sanders talk about the opioid epidemic and factory closures on the radio one day from his food truck, issues he'd seen firsthand growing up in East Tennessee. He went on to work twice on Bernie's presidential campaigns, in 2016 and 2020, and along the way co-founded Brand New Congress and [Justice Democrats](https://us.list-manage.com/Yf2xTfHWuwt?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), the groups that recruit and run working-class candidates for Congress. That work helped spot and elect AOC before anyone thought a bartender from the Bronx could beat a ten-term incumbent, and Corbin went on to become her first communications director on Capitol Hill.We get into the state of the Democratic Party, why the "socialist" label has become almost meaningless in political debate, healthcare and housing as supply problems, and his current project, a fully transparent super PAC called [A Fight Worth Having](https://us.list-manage.com/JuOdXRvBFKq?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), built to support progressive candidates across the country.This one's a real look at how movements get built from the ground up, starting right here in East Tennessee.Follow Corbin on [Substack](https://us.list-manage.com/zEcW9lnOw8a?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)! My name is Adam Kinzinger. You might know me as one of the only Republicans who served on the January 6th Committee, and one of 10 Republicans who voted to impeach Donald Trump.
I’ll be straight with you — I served in the House as a Republican for 12 years. But I’m doing what I can to help re-elect Eugene Vindman to Congress. Because at the end of the day, our democracy matters more than party or politics. And I have immense respect for people who believe in something, and hold fast to it regardless of pressure. Eugene is the textbook example of service and patriotism.
Like me, Eugene is a veteran.
I served this country flying KC-135s and RC-26Bs with multiple tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, and Eugene is a retired U.S. Army officer who served our nation with distinction, including on the National Security Council, where he stood up for what was right when the stakes couldn’t be higher.
We both took an oath to the Constitution — and we’ve both lived that oath through service and sacrifice.
Eugene and I won’t agree on everything. But I trust him to tell the truth, continue to fight for our democracy, and put the country ahead of politics.
But it’s going to take all of us doing our part to make sure leaders like Eugene can continue to serve.
So I’m asking:
[**Can you make a contribution to Eugene Vindman’s campaign before his deadline on Monday? His average online contribution is around $25. Some give more, some give less — every dollar helps and adds up quickly when people come together. >>**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-aug26?refcode=em260828-Kinzinger&amount=3&refcode2=1091_3892029_5x8xeB&akid=1091%2E3892029%2E5x8xeB)

President Trump says that number is going to explode. This is not speculation. This is not a leak. This is the federal government's own data confirming what Republican Attorneys General have said for years. While the media mocked election integrity concerns as fringe conspiracy theories, RAGA's Attorneys General were doing the actual work. Filing lawsuits. Demanding citizenship verification. Fighting for clean voter rolls in state after state. Now the numbers are proving us right. "President Trump is calling for the SAVE America Act to pass. We agree. And we need Republican Attorneys General in every state ready to enforce it when it does." This is the moment RAGA exists for. Help us keep exposing the truth as the rest of the data comes in. Every dollar helps our AGs finish what this investigation started. \- Republican Attorneys General "P.S: 32,000,000 more records are being checked right now. Chip in today before the next batch of numbers drops. " * | Paid for by Republican Attorneys General Association.

All last month, we were DEADLOCKED in a tie at 47% - 47%. We were holding on for dear life despite being outraised and outspent.

[**But at some point, the numbers win. Math doesn’t lie.**](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJycks-u4yoMh5-G7KiCyd9FFlc3qjSLM6vqzBK54LToEIiApJ23H3HaeYHZoU8_bH-Wf32oD7TO-ttPXGnSh1UxKevpoJjvYb_dszWPaDP9Djs6BTV0vB44DAp1tgepBiszadNJqGgS_dCPYpQA1X0yiA0s7ZWWttUwUifgCoDQkZFLi1jZqZSrBxgEiBbEqVu0GcRC2LeduFLPmnrfDGZKJx18onhg6Wm9D-UV_EmHtXLTPectMfkfgzODcyK9Rzo9rI9kSoLB2cekGZwzOoxWB64DpoyOk7OZEv_a8JmD5wdw4huWOvK851WtZOy-MjnTitYx6ApMYY-amJwDrKqkv2nWTM7_f_7gf6XeXOO6ob15JudMT0xLeHp6pC04x7829W6tXhO-fgSfyWcm52X3JqJN1t8YdLjmLSRbxJmcmxdpmJxFXTPoYvGOJSrnHHdi0NFTZWuYnN8ztepy4Z-XkxB9M4wqi3EcBUje9m0VJ7M9rHM2dWXxtyL8vd_8j2dxTPAnAAD__0UCypA)

Those are the cold, hard facts of our race.

So now comes the worst part of this job: having to ask for money.

I really hate it. As Attorney General, I’d much rather be beating the radical left in court and fighting for your constitutional rights. And as Senator, I’d much rather be saving our country.

[But when our opponent has _**TRIPLE**_ the amount of cash in the bank as we do, I have no choice but to ask for your help.](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJycks-u4yoMh5-G7KiCyd9FFlc3qjSLM6vqzBK54LToEIiApJ23H3HaeYHZoU8_bH-Wf32oD7TO-ttPXGnSh1UxKevpoJjvYb_dszWPaDP9Djs6BTV0vB44DAp1tgepBiszadNJqGgS_dCPYpQA1X0yiA0s7ZWWttUwUifgCoDQkZFLi1jZqZSrBxgEiBbEqVu0GcRC2LeduFLPmnrfDGZKJx18onhg6Wm9D-UV_EmHtXLTPectMfkfgzODcyK9Rzo9rI9kSoLB2cekGZwzOoxWB64DpoyOk7OZEv_a8JmD5wdw4huWOvK851WtZOy-MjnTitYx6ApMYY-amJwDrKqkv2nWTM7_f_7gf6XeXOO6ob15JudMT0xLeHp6pC04x7829W6tXhO-fgSfyWcm52X3JqJN1t8YdLjmLSRbxJmcmxdpmJxFXTPoYvGOJSrnHHdi0NFTZWuYnN8ztepy4Z-XkxB9M4wqi3EcBUje9m0VJ7M9rHM2dWXxtyL8vd_8j2dxTPAnAAD__0UCypA)

| | Dear Friend, This officer was just convicted of manslaughter for trying to stop a fleeing criminal with non-lethal force. Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD. He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. **Now he's fighting for his own freedom** – [**and he needs your help.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODJ9AAwAAAAAAp9dFEt4al4HCp7Zsy2kdgiUh4aAaxwcUiUqNq_RVjzNph8Prvf_orPvMWWAL9wffTPE9i36ei2wBvFuMSzRvYpMpDQSQUbS74yyCHYA) All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx.
---
| | [](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODJ9AAwAAAAAAp9dFEt5oFKSCHnhu7EuME0MReNNFmHte0BjmTSSCmf-TsfkGRTvHR5z01QtrrzrRJxLhBDeTZS2TFGsqUsmpozqoiMtYtxiTTGu4exG)
---
[ **Support Sgt. Duran** ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODJ9AAwAAAAAAp9dFEt61dmRoCULF2FU0yQVT0r8Onl773-tBJdsR-CfF_OY132n7WkhRVTCaPzZWGmVIaq7Ut7FQyM91gDcrXQbtgTZIGLzQyJsiwp4)
---
| | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled. Duran had only moments to react. He didn't reach for his firearm. He didn't use deadly force. **Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him.** The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries. Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison. And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. [**Will you help Sgt. Duran fight for his freedom?**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODJ9AAwAAAAAAp9dFEt7gIEpDKe3JOcxkGXWCJFyd9HW4EJclIly8JbYaDjHBkvjX58cGm5tMyXEGc1o4OWhi1-F5oNx9CLnPug21NPjI6ZXMT3VfERZ) The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal. But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive. And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. **They’re not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison.** **Their own lives have been threatened because of this case.** That's why I’m asking for your help today. **[Please make a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, or more to help fund Sgt. Duran's appeal and give him the resources he needs to fight for his freedom.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODJ9AAwAAAAAAp9dFEt8pZKU4b8o-ztg-R_sOHlmJAUEZF7VYuS6Eg-QNcUIqTIVWd1eTekOs1cCwO4C06ZCv8OcQ2iCZy7mnS96vwD5iH14C6mGbLK7)** **_Erik spent 15 years protecting others._** **_Now he needs people like you standing behind him.[Every donation makes a difference.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5ODJ9AAwAAAAAAp9dFEt9IYnjp3FewFV8ek8TXQU0k88LX6mwM9bScOLtfo-TGAG8RbX1oWCinM7qxVFshfqNjqbGQFbWCuJXISyK8eX4xm3AO71BFaIa)_** **_Thank you for standing with Sgt. Duran._** Sincerely,
---
| | | **Jason Johnson, President** _**
Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund**_

Sgt. Erik Duran dedicated 15 years of his life to the NYPD. He earned dozens of commendations. He helped take illegal guns off the streets. He put his life on the line to protect his community. Now he's fighting for his own freedom – All because of a split-second decision he made during a drug bust in the Bronx. | | | | | An undercover officer had just purchased narcotics from a suspect. As officers moved in to make the arrest, the suspect jumped on a motorized scooter and fled. Duran had only moments to react. He didn't reach for his firearm. He didn't use deadly force. Instead, he grabbed a nearby cooler and threw it into the suspect's path to stop him. The suspect crashed and later died from his injuries. Now, Sgt. Duran has been convicted of manslaughter and sentenced to prison. And he is fighting to clear his name through the appeals process. This appeal is his only chance to avoid spending the next 9 years behind bars with the very criminals he spent his career putting away. The Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) is standing with Sgt. Duran and helping fund his appeal. But legal battles like this are long, difficult, and incredibly expensive. And while Erik fights for his freedom, his wife and children are left carrying the burden alongside him. They’re not only facing the reality of their husband and father spending the next 9 years in prison. Their own lives have been threatened because of this case. That's why I’m asking for your help today. Erik spent 15 years protecting others. Now he needs people like you standing behind him. Thank you for standing with Sgt. Duran. Hi there Peter, it's Michele Tafoya!

If I were to take a guess, there's a 50/50 chance you may recognize me from a stadium's big screen.
If that's not the case, I get it... Let me at least tell you briefly about who I am and what I'm about anyway!

I should clarify first, no, I didn't make my career running for touchdowns or kicking game-winning field goals.

I worked as a sideline reporter in professional football for nearly three decades. Working in the sport for that long was a dream come true, and I wouldn't have wanted it any other way.
[Believe me, I know plenty of people who called me crazy for walking away from a career I loved. But life is short, and I was not willing to sit on the sidelines while everything I care about was on the line.](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/4R59BZLgQu3HU2UCR0edzM7O4vkWTO09RbvjT3ILyD0_2njcXGRQAI0_8AoQe8Ss_9UAeI3StuhvsRMpGWsG5fO8Lg4T3rq5AU_KmotnxT6R_QG8hfHgZI3PbYxddJhmNXLQxlEChOFnzmbjb2aha364B8g973UA5TfgxrhazltDLXJ1jtgSO2t82-DjdgyEH_VRvDimn-G2VvzMw8EgSi_LP9Q4jJCZlZrjMbyezVGgORPADu4pWTz9qHSf_tK-lTNJbVdL6P46Lzz-2qFBQCw0fbDBaso6FDCAmxZdoz1w8I9fLUOiigGJjY0_GkvNHHo8yy49xaokh7kYaaI-a7Iuac7ijMWiDHtttGNspoHM_5nPN6sAHvBtP_rFJ7mWJkypjcQVqBjnmMIVo5f-uBlalPPnjYMQkI1RuBvr2Q7mQMpMy28ENY53QpLwH32XbpBVx3AtRx7uzscl8P6PZZx_D1kN6DMyagLwOFZhnVU6dwiiZDJ60eShToZCiAs141Ct_AnP7sV_k2Ld8XWpp4y6fqeWgTTQ8IAi6LaX-MxJbCMyb9UUkFYC_sgat-qUQRTcZZ_V7Gn63Vwo_0C5xwrWR178iWNA8saxIcvwHFtSxb6PWaVvUEA7bL4mo17bO-11z3Mlb2aLaZNnovQUt-C0U82sRRtAnaIvEu4JjgL71ZTVf8L1e1DjKZj6IK405AL8lKtsATtr5mHV4qbDrCcQsBibkcI-HonkY0dKd-H8iLZhODFqbvBjKhcqWMvlZCBxXJnTiE2C5kj_DtVhEBvy4Xe6q-BSLjE_5Q4lJT72r94PkmgIRQH5EYKWaQJHklXS4fGxGmdkjwB9e8H8WazF2tEbioyL1Ths6JMIcg/mlMvEElkT_oYo9Za0tqUmyy2Yh4HgIyP/24)
I told myself before I officially launched my race for U.S. Senate that we had to be all in or not do it at all.

I burned the boats, Peter, and there's absolutely no looking back.
I will not be canceled. I will not apologize for values that are wholesome and good. And if my voice gives someone else the courage to use theirs, that is exactly why I did it.

I want my daughter and every young American to know one thing:
You earn your place. You think for yourself. And you never let anyone put you in a box. That's the Minnesota I'm fighting for.
Parents who speak up are called transphobes.Girls who lose opportunities are told to be quiet.And women's groups are nowhere to be found.
This is not complicated.
Girls' sports are for girls, and boys' sports are for boys.

The radical Left has done everything in its power to infiltrate some of the most vulnerable minds in our society. I launched this run because just like you, I'm sick of the indoctrination and want to bring back sanity to our country.

It's going to be FAR from easy. Minnesota hasn't had a Republican Senator in nearly two decades! However, it's ripe for a flip....with the disastrous leadership of Governor Walz and the Democratic Party in the state, people are fed up.

It's going to take a grassroots army of patriots, just like you, to propel this movement of ours to victory and shock the world.

All last month, we were DEADLOCKED in a tie at 47% - 47%. We were holding on for dear life despite being outraised and outspent.

[**But at some point, the numbers win. Math doesn’t lie.**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckkGPmzAQhX-NuTnCYzBw4FAJpadt97Bqj5aDZ8lojY3sIUn_fcVu-gd6fX5-877R_H6xL44CxeWHW3Fc0rbZXCxFvGHma9qXK5O_Z2L8k3YXLNRgZN1L6K2bmW5oG1f5sXGmMcZUOKqu7wZQSvXVdXRGD-1w6VrAbvZO6a712PVoAGrT60tF4xFY99AraFplTkYPdddftMZLq807iKZGT5zy6eiWsZDHyOTCaU5rFcYr81aE_ibgLOBccN4znu4UM_rDIeAcc5kFnNkFl2lOck6usAsSAzEW-bG5B6cobyBRbu7I0eedV7uip30VesLVURBgDrGkPc8o9JRgtYf7U-VZ6On7z9dX-Y_m-TC7dXO0RKEnxocr7-kR8V62FIL82Oxztv2q-PUjRcbIQk_ve_TZUaG4CDBu5S0VYkpHWPOlNEJPqq4FmHyA58OqJ847CjD4sExe6OnZqbVvb_LX20mprukHy2oYBgVatl1b5dFvdwqBiulEUy8H8eeC-X9P4jbC3wAAAP__uwHGxQ)

[**Talarico has $21.5 million in the bank. So now comes the worst part of this job: having to ask for money.

I really hate it. As Attorney General, I’d much rather be beating the radical left in court and fighting for your constitutional rights. And as Senator, I’d much rather be saving our country.

[But when our opponent has _**TRIPLE**_ the amount of cash in the bank as we do, I have no choice but to ask for your help.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckkGPmzAQhX-NuTnCYzBw4FAJpadt97Bqj5aDZ8lojY3sIUn_fcVu-gd6fX5-877R_H6xL44CxeWHW3Fc0rbZXCxFvGHma9qXK5O_Z2L8k3YXLNRgZN1L6K2bmW5oG1f5sXGmMcZUOKqu7wZQSvXVdXRGD-1w6VrAbvZO6a712PVoAGrT60tF4xFY99AraFplTkYPdddftMZLq807iKZGT5zy6eiWsZDHyOTCaU5rFcYr81aE_ibgLOBccN4znu4UM_rDIeAcc5kFnNkFl2lOck6usAsSAzEW-bG5B6cobyBRbu7I0eedV7uip30VesLVURBgDrGkPc8o9JRgtYf7U-VZ6On7z9dX-Y_m-TC7dXO0RKEnxocr7-kR8V62FIL82Oxztv2q-PUjRcbIQk_ve_TZUaG4CDBu5S0VYkpHWPOlNEJPqq4FmHyA58OqJ847CjD4sExe6OnZqbVvb_LX20mprukHy2oYBgVatl1b5dFvdwqBiulEUy8H8eeC-X9P4jbC3wAAAP__uwHGxQ)

body:
Please don’t skip this message.
#

❗ Friends: Please don’t skip this important message. This is for everybody who cares about our movement for gun safety.
Today is Friday, August 28. The Trump administration is trying to change the rules to let the USPS deliver guns through the mail — with no background checks or training needed — and we need you to help speak out.

For the past 99 years, federal law has banned the United States Postal Service from carrying or delivering handguns as mail — with exceptions for members of the military, law enforcement, or licensed gun manufacturers or dealers.
**Donald Trump is moving to change that.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260828-1-b&t=1&akid=11768%2E3935704%2EG23GEc)
His Department of Justice recently issued a memorandum saying that they would no longer enforce this ban. Now, the USPS is proposing a change to their existing regulations.

If this rule goes into effect, it would mean people who shouldn’t have a gun will be able to go around state and federal laws and get a gun mailed to them.
**This change also means that gun traffickers have a new way to move firearms through America’s communities.** At a time when gun violence is the #1 killer of kids and teenagers in our country...this rule would make us all less safe. We need to fight back.

You have helped us so much fighting back against extremist legislation and passing gun safety laws. Now, we need your support again to push back on this proposed rule.
[**Please, will you please make a grassroots donation to help GIFFORDS PAC today? Our average online donation is around $27. Some give more, others give less. What matters most is that you are taking action today in the fight to make our communities safer.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260828-1-b&t=2&akid=11768%2E3935704%2EG23GEc)

**Connecting with Conroy – August, 27th, 2026**
This has been a jam-packed summer. From festivals to parades and fairs, community events, and our great county party events, to having the honor of welcoming Vice President JD Vance to the West Side of Cincinnati, this summer has given me memories I will never forget. It has been amazing getting the chance to meet so many great people of Southwest Ohio.As we head into the fall, I am filled with excitement and energy. Our campaign has momentum, and we feel it every day on the ground. We are ramping up for a very busy fall, and we ask all of you to join our team and help us achieve victory this November. Please knock on doors, put out signs, and tell your friends, family, and neighbors who I am and why I am running. Together, we will flip this seat and create a more affordable, more prosperous Cincinnati and Southwest Ohio. - Eric Conroy

# MEDIA ADVISORY

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
August 28, 2026

**CONTACT**
Todd Cheewing
Todd@Ascent-Strategic.com
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** **PRESS ADVISORY: LILY TANG WILLIAMS HEADS TO THE NORTH COUNTRY** WEARE, N.H. — Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams will spend the final weekends before the September state primary meeting directly with North Country voters, attending the Colebrook Moose Festival on Friday before continuing her “Ask Me Anything” Town Hall Series in Berlin on Saturday.
The back-to-back North Country stops underscore her commitment to meet voters face-to-face in all corners of the district, taking their questions, and hearing firsthand about the issues affecting their families and communities.
Williams’ “Ask Me Anything” series is built around a simple promise: your questions, her answers — no scripted questions and no issue off limits. **FRIDAY, AUGUST 28 — COLEBROOK MOOSE FESTIVAL** Location: Colebrook, New Hampshire Event: Annual Moose Festival Williams will attend the Moose Festival to meet with North Country residents, local businesses, and visitors ahead of Monday’s debate. **SATURDAY, AUGUST 29 — BERLIN “ASK ME ANYTHING” TOWN HALL** Time: 2:30 PM – 4:00 PM Location: Berlin Recreation Center Address: 672 First Avenue, Berlin, NH Format: Open Q&A with Granite State voters Media: Open to the press

**About Lily Tang Williams**
Born in China just before Mao’s Cultural Revolution to working-class parents, Lily Tang Williams immigrated to the United States with nothing and built a life as an entrepreneur, educator, and community leader in Weare, NH. A living embodiment of the American Dream, she brings a uniquely powerful perspective to the fight for freedom and limited government.

In 2024, Williams won the Republican nomination and captured 47% of the general election vote against current incumbent Maggie Goodlander — coming closer than any Republican has in more than a decade to flipping NH-02. She is back and running stronger than ever in 2026.

body:
We will fight for every voter

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/1ed777dfbcbf/breaking-news-citizens-only-voting-amendment-submitted-to-board-of-canvassers-8371926?e=ecf60db114)

| |

Dear Friends,
**We promised you we would fight for every valid signature and every Michigan voter who signed our petition. Today, we are keeping that promise.**
Americans for Citizen Voting has filed a writ of mandamus with the Michigan Supreme Court seeking immediate relief following Monday's 2-2 deadlock by the Michigan Board of State Canvassers on certification of the Citizen Only Voting Amendment for the November 3 ballot.
More than 700,000 Michiganders signed our petition. They participated in a constitutional process and asked for the opportunity to have this proposal placed before Michigan voters.
We believe their voices deserve to be heard.
At Monday's meeting, the Board repeatedly deadlocked on disputed signatures. Nine Michigan voters went so far as to submit sworn, notarized affidavits confirming that they personally signed our petition. Yet the Board declined to consider those affidavits.
One of those voters, Fred Smith of Fowlerville, has now joined our case as a plaintiff. His signature had been rejected, but his sworn affidavit confirming that he signed the petition was not considered after the Board deadlocked on whether to accept it.
This is why we are asking the Michigan Supreme Court to intervene.
**This case is about something bigger than our amendment. It is about whether Michigan citizens who follow the law and participate in the constitutional petition process are entitled to due process.**
We know we submitted enough valid signatures to qualify for the ballot. We believe valid Michigan voters should have their valid signatures counted. And we believe a partisan deadlock should not be permitted to determine whether citizens receive the due process guaranteed to them under Michigan law.
**The people of Michigan did exactly what their Constitution asks of them. They signed petitions, they followed the rules, and they earned the right to have their voices heard.**
The Citizen Only Voting Amendment would clarify that only U.S. citizens may vote in Michigan elections, require voters appearing to vote to present valid photo identification, require the Secretary of State to verify citizenship using available records, and require systematic reviews of Michigan's voter rolls for accuracy.
But the question immediately before the Supreme Court is about the petition process itself.
Michigan's Constitution reserves to its citizens the power to propose constitutional amendments. That process is intentionally difficult. We knew that when we began.
**We gathered the signatures.
We followed the process.
We submitted the evidence.
Voters themselves came forward to verify their signatures.**
Now we are asking the Court to ensure that the constitutional petition process is fairly administered and that valid signatures receive the consideration required by law.
Time is short. Ballot preparation and printing deadlines for the November 3 general election are rapidly approaching, which is why our filing asks the Michigan Supreme Court for immediate relief.
We will continue pursuing the legal process and will keep you informed as the case moves forward.
Most importantly, thank you.
More than 700,000 Michiganders put their names on this petition. Thousands more volunteered, circulated petitions, attended events and supported this effort along the way.
We have not forgotten what you asked us to do.
**We will continue to pursue every available legal avenue for a fair review of the petition and the signatures submitted by Michigan voters.**
Their voices matter. Their signatures matter. And the constitutional process matters. It’s time to LET THE PEOPLE DECIDE.
Thank you for standing with us,
Americans for Citizen Voting-Michigan

**P.S. If you can, please consider contributing $1, $5, $10, $25 or more, every dollar helps fund the upcoming legal battle!**

clean_body: We will fight for every voter | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Dear Friends, We promised you we would fight for every valid signature and every Michigan voter who signed our petition. Today, we are keeping that promise. Americans for Citizen Voting has filed a writ of mandamus with the Michigan Supreme Court seeking immediate relief following Monday's 2-2 deadlock by the Michigan Board of State Canvassers on certification of the Citizen Only Voting Amendment for the November 3 ballot. More than 700,000 Michiganders signed our petition. They participated in a constitutional process and asked for the opportunity to have this proposal placed before Michigan voters. We believe their voices deserve to be heard. At Monday's meeting, the Board repeatedly deadlocked on disputed signatures. Nine Michigan voters went so far as to submit sworn, notarized affidavits confirming that they personally signed our petition. Yet the Board declined to consider those affidavits. One of those voters, Fred Smith of Fowlerville, has now joined our case as a plaintiff. His signature had been rejected, but his sworn affidavit confirming that he signed the petition was not considered after the Board deadlocked on whether to accept it. This is why we are asking the Michigan Supreme Court to intervene. This case is about something bigger than our amendment. It is about whether Michigan citizens who follow the law and participate in the constitutional petition process are entitled to due process. We know we submitted enough valid signatures to qualify for the ballot. We believe valid Michigan voters should have their valid signatures counted. And we believe a partisan deadlock should not be permitted to determine whether citizens receive the due process guaranteed to them under Michigan law. The people of Michigan did exactly what their Constitution asks of them. They signed petitions, they followed the rules, and they earned the right to have their voices heard. The Citizen Only Voting Amendment would clarify that only U.S. citizens may vote in Michigan elections, require voters appearing to vote to present valid photo identification, require the Secretary of State to verify citizenship using available records, and require systematic reviews of Michigan's voter rolls for accuracy. But the question immediately before the Supreme Court is about the petition process itself. Michigan's Constitution reserves to its citizens the power to propose constitutional amendments. That process is intentionally difficult. We knew that when we began. We gathered the signatures. We followed the process. We submitted the evidence. Voters themselves came forward to verify their signatures. Now we are asking the Court to ensure that the constitutional petition process is fairly administered and that valid signatures receive the consideration required by law. Time is short. Ballot preparation and printing deadlines for the November 3 general election are rapidly approaching, which is why our filing asks the Michigan Supreme Court for immediate relief. We will continue pursuing the legal process and will keep you informed as the case moves forward. Most importantly, thank you. More than 700,000 Michiganders put their names on this petition. Thousands more volunteered, circulated petitions, attended events and supported this effort along the way. We have not forgotten what you asked us to do. We will continue to pursue every available legal avenue for a fair review of the petition and the signatures submitted by Michigan voters. Their voices matter. Their signatures matter. And the constitutional process matters. It’s time to LET THE PEOPLE DECIDE. Thank you for standing with us, Americans for Citizen Voting-Michigan P.S. If you can, please consider contributing $1, $5, $10, $25 or more, every dollar helps fund the upcoming legal battle! | | | | We are going to need our entire grassroots nation to get out and support this effort. Go to our website to sign up for updates, like and follow us on social media and help us spread the word. This issue will be critical to 2026 and we need you! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2026 Americans for Citizen Voting Michigan. All rights reserved._
