name: Sam Forstag
subject: Here’s how we take our country back
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Truth to Power PAC
body:
We’ll win by giving working people something to believe in
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41556%2E3422442%2EuoUO16)
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260828_1_ak.XBOre8&refcode=em20260828-41556&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41556%2E3422442%2EuoUO16)
Peter, this year, we’re going to flip Montana’s 1st Congressional District from red to blue.
**And when we do, we’ll make sure Congress starts working for working people again.**
The numbers back it up: analysts found that in 2025, Democrats did about 13 points better in contested elections than they had in 2024. Not only is that more than Donald Trump and Ryan Zinke’s 2024 margins in MT-01, we know that Jon Tester won this district in Montana that same year.
This race is completely winnable, but we need to win in a way that brings working people back to the Democratic party so we can build lasting power. We can do that, but I’ll need your help.
**[Can you chip in now and split a donation between Truth to Power and our campaign?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260828_1_ak.XBOre8&refcode=em20260828-41556&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41556%2E3422442%2EuoUO16)**
[Donate ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260828_1_ak.XBOre8&refcode=em20260828-41556&t=22&akid=41556%2E3422442%2EuoUO16)
I also know that Democrats have real, deep work to do to win back working people’s trust.
As a smokejumper and union leader, I have worked alongside the folks we’ve been losing. I understand what it’s like to work 1,000 hours of overtime and still be holding on by my fingernails. We can build a winning campaign and rebuild the Democratic Party _one honest conversation at a time._
We need to prove to working people that it’s worth engaging in the political process — that we can get Congress back to making people’s lives materially better by electing leaders who know what a hard day’s work looks like. I’ll fight for real, bold changes to fix health care, housing, and retirement by making corporations and the ultra-wealthy carry their own damn weight, just like the rest of us.
**[This won’t be easy, and it’s going to take _all of us_ doing what we can — and pitching in whenever we can. Please donate whatever you can today to fuel us all the way to victory in November.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260828_1_ak.XBOre8&refcode=em20260828-41556&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=41556%2E3422442%2EuoUO16)**
Thank you for being in this fight,
Sam

Former U.S. Congresswoman Katie Porter founded Truth to Power to support the campaigns of her fellow Democrats. Truth to Power supports candidates who will stand up to Donald Trump, fight to lower costs, and protect the environment. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20260828-41556&amounts=&t=24&refcode2=41556_3422442_uoUO16&akid=41556%2E3422442%2EuoUO16)**

This is worrying, Peter.

Peter, Roy Cooper here. I’m worried.
We’re coming up on our crucial end-of-month deadline, and unfortunately, we’re not where we need to be to reach our goal. [**_If you’re able to chip in today for the first time to help us get back on track, it would make a big impact and mean a lot to me._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1181&amount=5&t=9&akid=3041%2E124072%2EouAAhU)
Here’s why we’re trying to raise $2 million (I know – it’s ambitious) before the end of the month:
North Carolina is where the fight for U.S. Senate control will be won or lost. Flipping this seat is a _must_ if we’re going to take back the majority, and that’s why the GOP is going all in to defeat me.
Republican super PACs are flooding this race with nearly $100 million so far to crush our momentum. President Trump is smearing my name to his millions of followers on social media. His buddy Stephen Miller even went on Fox News recently to rant and rave about me.
Their attacks are working: We’re getting outspent, and a brand-new poll shows this race is now statistically tied.
**If folks like you chip in and we hit our $2 million goal, we’ll be able to keep up with the GOP and ensure this race stays competitive. If we don’t meet this goal, we won’t.**
[**_That’s why this is so important, Peter, so I have to ask: Will you give $5 or whatever amount you can spare today to help us reach our goal, flip North Carolina and take back the Senate majority?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1181&amount=5&t=10&akid=3041%2E124072%2EouAAhU)

Federal agents took Marvin Godoy Calderon - a janitor with a legal work permit - off a San Francisco street in broad daylight.

They choked Iryna Gorb at SFO. They arrested a 5-year-old, Liam Conejo Ramos, to lure his mother out of her home; he's now in a detention center 1,300 miles away.

In Minneapolis, they shot and killed Renee Good and Alex Pretti in broad daylight and they are refusing to investigate.

Almost none of these people can sue because a loophole in federal law has made ICE agents essentially immune from the Constitution.

Yesterday, the California Legislature passed my No Kings Act to end that loophole.

**My No Kings Act lets Californians take ICE, Border Patrol, and other federal agents to court when they violate our constitutional rights - and we made it retroactive to March 2025, so people whose rights have already been violated get a path to justice too. It's the first bill in the country to do this.**

**It is now on Governor Newsom's desk but he only has until September 30 to act. If he signs it, it takes effect immediately.**

They choked Iryna Gorb at SFO. They arrested a 5-year-old, Liam Conejo Ramos, to lure his mother out of her home; he's now in a detention center 1,300 miles away. In Minneapolis, they shot and killed Renee Good and Alex Pretti in broad daylight and they are refusing to investigate. Almost none of these people can sue because a loophole in federal law has made ICE agents essentially immune from the Constitution. Yesterday, the California Legislature passed my No Kings Act to end that loophole. My No Kings Act lets Californians take ICE, Border Patrol, and other federal agents to court when they violate our constitutional rights - and we made it retroactive to March 2025, so people whose rights have already been violated get a path to justice too. body:
Powerful people start wars. Working families are left carrying the consequences. | |
---
Peter, Six months ago, Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth launched an unauthorized war with Iran. Trump said it would be over “very soon.” **Instead, six months later, families are still living with the consequences of decisions made by powerful people who have faced almost none themselves.** From the beginning, those consequences have been devastating. On February 28, a strike destroyed the Shajareh Tayyebeh school in Minab, where Iran reported that 156 people were killed -- most of them schoolchildren. Hegseth has still failed to provide the kind of accountability such a horrific loss of life demands. **And the damage has not stopped overseas. Hegseth's Pentagon is not communicating truthfully with families and the public here at home. Members of Congress are demanding answers about whether the Pentagon has obscured the true number of U.S. servicemembers killed in this war.** Sailors aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln endured an extraordinarily long deployment without a port call as lawmakers and families raised alarms about deteriorating conditions and mental health aboard the ship. The people who start these wars are rarely the people forced to carry their consequences. Military families are. Working people are. And now, six months into Trump and Hegseth’s unnecessary, illegal war, the _New York Times_ is reporting: [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-9rN1xzoKhxCzUXAGh_rNYlCzZzjdkfj-kTm1MrlmZ4-omtT6GaFYZ2KdUIQCro3WAmDSMT33SYxGOcxL0SmjlGH9Qw93tHKQwlP5XkzanlZICRZ1PrL_BS5VoXXpnrYtcgzSuGlVr7k1L0Troyw7Njjw8ga-bT-_KejOCqoR3c9SopuSi76yvwqapxPto-dzH8q9wY0Hq3c-ZUU0W0ipaQ1RIQyJJVd7ztwECp3B3nZw4-k1EMLWtXvyQuCSzKAVuVjeCDEnWu8lED2gSiflV5ecKmRMv8swqYR6179Id3fHIlC0SmGbYVmRRO5rDpKiHT36G_q5lVFUeVUOxFfRMntUb63DnXndd_uT8B9Wd20sQlLLnohAYMt-2fjQKHDxmwgrEhGxPo4Eu-Nr13DdEewPRwakJrrn6DAFnmIn39Q/4tk/sgfcw1RuQQ6OizlgQ0wJlg/h0/h001.ahmjhEjCCV9sven5IoF_XT2U_TV95LxH33u0lJKpGao) **Communities fighting for affordable housing, strong public schools, healthcare, and clean air and water are told again and again that there is never enough for us, while this administration keeps finding money for wars that Congress never authorized.** ****[**Enough is enough. **Politicians won’t hold powerful people accountable simply because it is the right thing to do. History teaches us that real accountability comes when ordinary people organize together, build collective power, and make ignoring us impossible.**
Every person who refuses to accept endless war as normal makes this movement stronger. And every community that demands answers makes it harder for Hegseth and the Trump administration to hide behind secrecy, excuses, or the expectation that people will eventually stop paying attention.
We organize because the decisions made in Washington shape what becomes possible in our neighborhoods. Whether the issue is war, housing, schools, healthcare, voting rights, or the air our children breathe, the same questions keep coming back: Who has the power to make decisions, and who is expected to live with the consequences?
We are building a movement where working people and our communities have enough power to answer that question for ourselves.**On this six-month anniversary, let’s make it clear that Hegseth cannot simply outlast public outrage and escape responsibility.**

So I will keep this short.| | | Peter, This is Mike Bouchard. I am going to keep this short, because I know you get a hundred of these. **My end-of-month deadline is midnight Monday.** I hate asking. I have never been good at it. In the Army you ask for help constantly. That is the whole point of a squad. But you are asking people who signed the same paperwork you did, who are already in it with you, and who would do the same for you without being asked. This is different. This is me asking you to fund something you never enlisted in. Here is where we are. **The Cook Political Report just moved this race from _Lean Republican_ to _Toss Up_**. My opponent has EMILY's List, Giffords, and the DCCC behind her. _I have you._ That is not a complaint. It is actually the part I am proud of. This campaign runs on people who send $10 and $25, not on a party account in Washington. **[So if you can send something before Monday, it goes straight into the work.](http://links.mikebouchardforcongress.com/u/click?_t=bb25c0b583c5471786d790f5e4203cc0&_m=ac7df975a4b64e69a7479df50ddaa430&_e=8a9W0kqlgJJzx6eKKJYu-jFsDV6E8RSXoMtvopXY5J3y7H0inZPY_a5ccj-Nqk1gSfRxytQC8Kh23ZIVEg9zJB_JBx0vi9ZsqoBMjfpbs2JAd2eXayyFtnf0LSTeruQQFygMP58sb3yjuBdU-Py8tGEaf6bwVpkVzoExPF4XL3_mPgnVGKhkheg0XCIqjqfiDgrDYpGKO7T_hHiI6i9hSDy5khpMpIjhJ2jVx4d7jXXJk6T30X0YIt5YdWtOdGhVzZHpF80eEZVUG14IdrrXSFa-9Q1rnl3fuCa7sgH_u-ZN68MrSWU61XRURJ8tyb_hAnRBiV_luhprK_1w19l03rtiPg8tP5ymo-fnHxc2bmjDYu8MqgS8HuvObDRdIqzlmsjdgTxEVrKPoFfeIa8ZpUh0tV1MqWaA_-HTh1gF6LhQ6geaTfVGoBiDvgNj85smvZp02Hgf0i5Vd6slCmWlDpesgDQjx9cjjZtGyp1kbqkUhsZ-ZRmDZirX9cvezRQAuKqtvAoPiYVpfWeTh5-okW_Dc8f-JaOWRL7AqTmKftHCR9EnPiDKmlzRCn6qw1yF)** Doors, phones, and getting my story in front of people who have never heard it. Mike here! My August 4 primary is almost here, and I have to be honest with you: I'm a soldier, not a fundraiser.
I'm running for Congress because Michigan's 10th deserves someone who has actually done hard things. I spent nine months in Iraq on a mission to defeat ISIS. I came home and filed for this race 12 days later. I didn't take a vacation, and I'm not taking a shortcut now.

Rick Jackson is betting that if he spends enough money, he can hide the fact that he got rich by profiting off our health care. He wants to hide the fact that he promised to be “Trump’s favorite Governor,” and that there’s not a single thing he disagrees with Trump on. He's betting that an $87 million wall of television ads will drown out every volunteer, every organizer, every small-dollar donor, and every conversation about what's really at stake in this election. **I'm betting he's wrong.** But only if we have the resources to fight back. That's why I instructed my team to start locking in our own TV reservations. Every day we wait, ad inventory becomes more expensive, more limited, and more valuable. If we're going to compete, we have to claim our place on the air now—not months from now. It's a big commitment for a grassroots campaign. But this campaign has never been built on billionaire checks.
